subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Cerberus the Gatekeeper
description: A fast breakdown of Cerberus the Gatekeeper for builders.

hook.text: A three-headed dog guards the gates of Hades. Cerberus lets the dead in but never lets them leave.

buildup.text: Each head reportedly watches a different direction—past, present, and future. Time itself guards the gate.

discovery.text: Heracles captured Cerberus bare-handed as his twelfth labor. The only hero who dragged death's dog out.

twist.text: Orpheus bypassed Cerberus with music. Not every guardian requires strength. Some yield to beauty.

climax.text: The gatekeeper symbol persists: heaven's gates, hell's gates—every afterlife needs someone at the door.

punchline.text: Three heads. One job. No one leaves.

quiz.question: How did Orpheus get past Cerberus?
